Settings.Storage.FooterAndroid: Android keeps models, recordings and app data in VoiceType’s private storage. Nothing leaves the phone, and Android removes it all when VoiceType is uninstalled.
Settings.Storage.FooterDesktop: Everything stays on this computer. A folder change never deletes or overwrites files: moves happen at the next start, as renames on the same drive.
Settings.Storage.Recordings.Title: Recordings
Settings.Storage.Recordings.What: Audio and transcripts saved to History
Settings.Storage.Recordings.QuestionTitl: Move recordings to the new folder?
Settings.Storage.Recordings.PendingNote: Recordings will move to {0} when the app restarts.
Settings.Storage.Recordings.SwitchNote: New recordings will be saved to {0} after the app restarts. Recordings in the old folder leave History until you choose it again.
Settings.Storage.Data.Title: App data
Settings.Storage.Data.What: Settings, chats, the job queue and logs
Settings.Storage.Data.QuestionTitle: Move app data to the new folder?
Settings.Storage.Data.Subject: App data ({0})
Settings.Storage.Data.PendingNote: App data will move to {0} when the app restarts.
Settings.Storage.Data.UnavailableNote: The app data folder {0} is not available. VoiceType uses the default folder {1} instead.
Settings.Storage.Question.OtherDriveMode: Models are not copied between drives automatically: they stay in the old folder, and you can copy them into the matching sub-folders (asr, llm, diarization) of the new folder yourself.
Settings.Storage.Question.OtherDriveReco: Recordings are not copied between drives automatically: they stay in the old folder.
Settings.Storage.Question.AfterModels: They move when the app restarts (same drive: instant, nothing is copied). Or keep them where they are and start the new folder empty.
Settings.Storage.Question.AfterRecording: They move when the app restarts (same drive: instant). Or keep them where they are: they then leave History until you choose the old folder again.
Settings.Storage.Question.AfterData: VoiceType moves settings, chats, the queue and logs when it restarts. Models and recordings stay in their own folders.

Settings.Compute.Cpu.Title: Processor (CPU)
